text.title: Mode
text.description: suggest to list emails ready to file; file to move the emails the user confirmed

text_1.title: BatchKey
text_1.description: The batchkey from the previous result, copied exactly. none for a new Help me file.

text_2.title: Selections
text_2.description: For file: comma-separated numbers from the list (each number is a whole conversation); all for every suggested one; replied or read for just that section; number=Folder name to send one elsewhere, e.g. 1,3,4,5=Cassin. none for suggest.
